title: Launch
summary: Memory Library's opening night: the exhibitions, Remembering Place and the Film Programme all open at once, 18:00-22:00.
body: Launch is the opening night of Memory Library. Resonate, Queer at Sea, Remembering Place and the Film Programme all open together, with a bar and the first chance to see the whole programme in one evening. Boathouse 5 isn't open during the day on the 13th - Launch is the only way in that day.

title: Resonate
summary: New commissions from Resonate, Play Office's artist development programme, shown continuously throughout Memory Library.
body: Resonate brings together new commissions developed through Play Office's artist development programme. The exhibition explores different relationships between technology, memory and heritage through the work of participating artists. It runs throughout Memory Library, so visitors can encounter the work as part of the wider programme at Boathouse 5.

title: Film Programme
summary: A continuous programme of moving-image work, showing throughout the day in the Cinema.
body: The Film Programme brings together moving-image work in the Cinema throughout Memory Library. Films will run continuously during the day, giving visitors the option to drop in as part of their visit. The programme sits alongside the exhibitions, talks, workshops and other activity taking place across Boathouse 5.

title: Queer at Sea
summary: An exhibition exploring queerness, coastal space and belonging, shown throughout the daily programme.
blurb: Exhibition on queerness and coastal life.
body: Queer at Sea is an exhibition curated by artist Hannah Buckingham, exploring queerness, coastal space and belonging. The exhibition considers the ways identity and place can become connected through personal and shared experience. It is shown throughout the daily Memory Library programme and can be visited at any point while the exhibition is open.

title: Past Makes Future
summary: A one-day conference and gathering bringing together international delegates, artists and heritage partners.
body: Past Makes Future is a one-day conference and gathering bringing together international delegates, artists and heritage partners. The day creates space for presentations, conversations and different perspectives on the relationships between culture, heritage and contemporary practice. It is part of the wider Memory Library programme at Boathouse 5.

title: Cairo - Artist Presentation
summary: A presentation from Raneem Elhaddad and Ahmed Nader, part of Past Makes Future.
body: Raneem Elhaddad and Ahmed Nader present as part of Past Makes Future and Memory Library's international programme. The session offers an opportunity to hear directly from the artists and learn more about their work and perspectives. Their participation forms part of the wider exchange between artists and organisations connected through Memory Library.

title: Pageant
summary: An evening performance closing Past Makes Future. Doors 19:30, performance from 20:00.
body: Pageant is an evening performance closing the Past Makes Future programme. Doors open at 19:30, with the performance beginning at 20:00. The event marks a shift from the talks and conversations of the day into an evening performance at Boathouse 5. This event has age guidance of 18+.

title: Remembering Place
summary: A collection of sculptures, like the sofa, where you can sit and chat or leave a memory. Here throughout Memory Library, whenever Boathouse 5 is open.
blurb: Sculptures to chat at or leave a memory.
body: People Library is a collection of sculptures that invite people to stop, sit and spend time together. Visitors can use pieces such as the sofa as a place to have a conversation or leave a memory of their own. The sculptures are here throughout Memory Library, so you can visit whenever Boathouse 5 is open - some hours are hosted, see Hosted Hours for details.

title: Remembering Together
summary: Drop by the People Library between 11am and 1pm most days, when someone is on hand to chat or help you leave a memory.
blurb: Hosted sessions at the People Library.
body: Most days, someone is at the People Library between 11:00 and 13:00 to chat, answer questions or help you leave a memory of your own. Outside these hours the sculptures are still there to visit, just unstaffed.

title: A Moment, Framed
summary: Led by Zihan Karim at Play Office, this hands-on mobile filmmaking workshop explores framing, perception and looking at familiar surroundings in new ways. Material created in the workshop will contribute to a new experimental artwork premiering at We Shine Community.
blurb: Create a short mobile film using handmade frames for a new We Shine Community artwork.
body:
What happens when we change the way we look?

Led by Zihan Karim, this hands-on workshop invites participants to use mobile video as a simple and intuitive way of observing and reimagining the world around them.

Each participant will be given a prompt word and invited to respond by making a short video using their mobile phone. Handmade paper cut-outs, including circles, squares, triangles and other shapes, will be used as physical frames or filters, creating small windows through which familiar surroundings can be seen differently.

The workshop is not about making a technically perfect film. Instead, it is an invitation to slow down, notice small details and experiment with framing, movement, light, texture and everyday objects.

Participants will move through the space creating their own responses to the same prompts. A single word might produce completely different images and interpretations, turning the workshop into a collective exploration of perception, memory and personal experience.

Material created during the workshop will then be used as part of an experimental new artwork, which will premiere at We Shine Community.

No previous filmmaking or artistic experience is required.

Please bring a mobile phone with a working camera. A laptop is optional if you would like to transfer or share your video files during the session.

title: Scanner Art Workshop
summary: Explore the use of scanners to create artwork with visiting artist Shohrab Jahan.
blurb: Workshop connected to Bangladesh. Held next door at Play Office.
body: This workshop is connected to Bangladesh and forms part of Memory Library's international exchange. It offers visitors a chance to take part in activity linked to the wider programme of visiting artists and international collaboration. It runs twice - this is the second session, at Play Office (The Old Pay Office, Victory Gate, HM Naval Base) next door to Boathouse 5.

title: Bangladesh Screening
summary: A screening connected to Bangladesh, part of Memory Library's international exchange.
body: This screening is connected to Bangladesh and forms part of Memory Library's international exchange. It brings work connected to the exchange into the Cinema as part of the wider programme. The screening sits alongside artist presentations, workshops and exhibitions taking place at Boathouse 5.

title: We Shine Community
summary: Boathouse 5 stays open into the evening as part of We Shine Community, with the exhibition continuing and the exterior projection running after dark.
blurb: Evening opening for We Shine Community.
body: Boathouse 5 stays open into the evening as part of We Shine Community. Visitors can continue exploring the Memory Library exhibition after dark, while the exterior projection runs outside the building. The later opening offers a different way to experience the programme as the Historic Dockyard moves into the evening.
